options.title: Options
options.description: Between 2 and 8 options, shown as A, B, C, ... in this order.

mode.title: Who scores
mode.description: majority: players who voted for the most popular option score. minority: players who voted for the least popular option that received votes score.

showLiveCounts.title: Show live counts
showLiveCounts.description: Show how many votes each option has on the main display while voting is open (votes stay anonymous).
